title: Mandatory universal access standards for sectors with disabilities
summary: New regulations compel all sectors to adopt universal access standards for individuals with disabilities.
body:

title: National Governance Council Launches Program to Support and Empower Persons with Disabilities
summary: The National Governance Council has announced a collaboration on a program designed to support and empower individuals with disabilities, aiming to enhance their integration and participation within the broader community.
body:
The National Governance Council has announced a collaboration on a program designed to support and empower individuals with disabilities, aiming to enhance their integration and participation within the broader community.
